title.narrative: Construction of the Mozambique-Malawi Interconnector

description.narrative: The Project consists of the construction of a 218 km long transmission line with a voltage level of 400 kV between Matambo, Tete Province, Mozambique, and Phombeya (Balaka District, Malawi). This Delagation Agreement covers the component within Malawi including: ¿Installation of approx. 76 km of 400 kV transmission line ¿Extension of Phombeya substation with transmission line bays.
